goal: Keep the Guix build environment current with newer upstream compilers and toolchains
Unblock native deterministic builds on RISC-V systems
agreement: Verified by matching Guix build hashes on x86_64 (0xB10C, willcl-ark)
Unaddressed objection: time-machine fails on riscv64 with an unbound variable error (maflcko)
Unaddressed objection: build fails on aarch64 hosts due to missing system headers (janb84, hebasto)
Unaddressed objection: codesign build fails from a missing setuptools dependency (willcl-ark)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it brings release toolchains up to date and fixes native builds on RISC-V
Keeping build manifests aligned with upstream Guix prevents toolchain obsolescence
